content_fields.title: Minimize host OS attack surface
content_fields.description: Minimize the attack surface of the hosts running this service.
content_fields.guidance: Container hosts should run a minimal operating system with unused services disabled, unnecessary packages removed, local firewalling enabled and remote access limited to a bastion path.
content_fields.found: The repository defines the container image but nothing about the host operating system it runs on.
content_fields.missing: Host build configuration and a hardening baseline.
content_fields.conclusion: Host hardening is applied to the machine image, outside this repository. The equivalent work inside the container image is tracked separately under the image attack-surface countermeasure.
content_fields.action: The platform team should apply the host hardening baseline to the container hosts.
